scope: Flow comparison, source review and additional production-stack dummy tests; live data not mutated

flow.step: Merchant profile → subscription → Villa → ownership upload
Trial approval activates QR without invoice
Paid document approval creates invoice but does not activate QR
Merchant slip → Admin reject/resubmit or confirm
No self-confirmation or reused bank transaction
Renewal retains QR; repeated approval cannot add validity twice
Suspension blocks payment activation and unavailable QR cannot match precheck
Guest masking, User contact access, role/ownership/CSRF guards
Reports: guest tracking, member linkage, Admin public reply/private notes
Guest counts: create/edit, review, filters and unknown data
Capacity limits and paid upgrade before extra Villa rights
flow.evidence: production-integration.log: full capacity requires paid upgrade; five package tiers

flow.basis: User confirmed trial service; not exercised against live provider

findings.issue: Public Last checked is populated from creation time instead of last Admin review
findings.resolution: Uses Admin reviewed_at; unknown review dates remain unknown; createdAt is separate

findings.issue: Suspended/cancelled subscriptions with a future expiry display expired-package guidance
findings.resolution: Suspended/cancelled notices and renewal/upgrade controls match lifecycle; Backend rejects blocked renewals

findings.issue: Starter promises downloadable QR, but current VillaQr renders SVG and link without QR download action; document/slip download actions are distinct
findings.resolution: SVG download tested and its image scanned back to original Villa QR

findings.issue: Monthly pricing is displayed as per month while first paid invoice grants three months; later renewals grant one month
findings.resolution: Confirmed first monthly payment grants 3 months and renewals 1; explanatory copy present in pricing, promotion and Merchant selection

limits: Live privileged Admin operations not mutated
The additional findings concern copy/date presentation, missing QR export and an unconfirmed commercial period rule; passing tests do not prove all displayed claims correct
